0022600135.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-2, third in the Central and one game back, eighth in the East) host the Philadelphia 76ers (3-1, second in the Atlantic and fourth in the East) in Indiana's fifth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Pacers coming off a loss and 0-1 at home, while Philadelphia has lost its last game. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain), Andrew Nembhard (neck soreness), Obi Toppin (hand sprain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring soreness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Indiana lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 105-94 in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
